criteria.config_echo: The address is host:port echoed from the validated configuration, naming the attempted bind (an ephemeral request echoes port 0). Identical on every platform; carries no errno, native message, or resolution detail.
criteria.native_detail: The address carries the native failure detail such as the errno code and Bun message text. Preserves operator debuggability while making the string platform-variant and partly redundant with the attempted address.
criteria.review_needed: The evidence cannot decide the address content, or neither content keeps the required contracts.

bind_address.instructions: Pick the content of the bind_failed address field: a deterministic echo of the attempted host:port from configuration, or the native failure detail from Bun. Weigh determinism and sanitization against debuggability using common and topics.bind_address.

criteria.review_needed: The evidence cannot separate the two validation splits, or neither split preserves the required contracts.
criteria.split_authority: Check only adapter-consumed numbers (body_limit and shutdown_ms ranges) at make_server_config. Accept any type-correct port and host there; Bun RangeError, resolution throws, and EADDRINUSE all surface as bind_failed at server_start. A single address authority with no duplicated rules.
criteria.static_first: Check port 0-65535, a non-empty NUL-free host of at most 253 chars, and the body_limit and shutdown_ms ranges at make_server_config, raising invalid_server_config with the field name as reason. Only name resolution and port availability reach server_start as bind_failed. Pure configuration mistakes stay reproducible without binding.

config_split.instructions: Choose which authority validates each configuration field: everything statically decidable at make_server_config with only bind-time facts left to Bun, or adapter numbers at config time with all address validation deferred to the bind verdict. Base the choice on common together with topics.config_split.

criteria.dispatch_bounded: Hold the server lease across snapshot, dispatch, and conversion, releasing before the fetch task returns its Response. Socket completion stays with native stop(false). Exactly one acquisition and one release per request, both inside the fetch task.
criteria.review_needed: The evidence cannot fix the lease span, or neither span keeps the required contracts.
criteria.socket_bounded: Hold the lease until the response body is fully sent by wrapping the body stream. Adds adapter gating beyond the native drain, with the release point living outside the fetch task in stream machinery.

lease_scope.instructions: Fix the span of the per-request server lease: across Can-side dispatch only with socket drain left native, or until the response body is fully sent. Use common and topics.lease_scope.

criteria.review_needed: The evidence cannot fix the numeric bounds, or neither bound pair keeps the required contracts.
criteria.sibling_mirror: body_limit accepts 1-67108864 and shutdown_ms accepts 0-2147483647, with violations raising invalid_server_config naming the field. Timers stay inside setTimeout exact range and the inbound bound matches the established sibling precedent.
criteria.unbounded_above: body_limit accepts any int >= 1 and shutdown_ms any safe int >= 0, with the adapter silently clamping timer arms to 2147483647. No upper rejections; very large values degrade to an approximately 24.8-day bound.

numeric_bounds.instructions: Fix the accepted ranges for body_limit and shutdown_ms: mirror the sibling bound and the exact timer range, or accept any non-negative magnitude with silent timer clamping. Use common and topics.numeric_bounds.

criteria.review_needed: The evidence cannot fix the phase vocabulary, or neither vocabulary keeps the required contracts.
criteria.single_phase: Report phase stop for every shutdown failure including caller-wait expiry. One phase to match; the caller infers a timeout from its own elapsed time rather than from the value.
criteria.two_phase: Report phase deadline when a bounded stop wait expires while the close continues, and phase stop when the native stop itself throws; server_wait relays the close completion phase. Callers can separate still-closing from close-failed.

phase_vocabulary.instructions: Fix the shutdown_failed phase vocabulary: distinct phases for caller-wait expiry versus native-stop failure, or one phase for every shutdown failure. Use common and topics.phase_vocabulary.

criteria.idempotent_settlement: Register the server idempotent. A repeated stop returns the shared settlement completion, including ok after close; convergence needs no swallowing. Double-stop scripts stay silent while staleness stays invisible.
criteria.resource_state: Register the server non-idempotent. A repeated stop during closing, or a stop on a closed handle, fails with standard resource_state; the signal handler tolerates already-closing. Observation stays server_wait work while stop reports staleness.
criteria.review_needed: The evidence cannot decide repeated-stop behavior, or neither behavior keeps the required contracts.

repeated_stop.instructions: Decide repeated and stale stop behavior: standard resource_state failures on a non-idempotent server, or the shared settlement from an idempotent server. Use common and topics.repeated_stop.

criteria.all_open: Each server_start installs one listener pair per server, removed at close; every open server closes on signal whether awaited or not. Uniform shutdown at the cost of changing default kill semantics from start onward.
criteria.review_needed: The evidence cannot fix signal ownership, or neither ownership keeps the required contracts.
criteria.waited_only: Each server_wait installs its own SIGINT/SIGTERM pair and removes it on settle, with the handler initiating the shared close. Servers without a waiter keep default process semantics; only awaited servers react.

signal_scope.instructions: Fix which servers react to SIGINT/SIGTERM: only servers with an active wait via waiter-owned listeners, or every open server via start-owned listeners. Use common and topics.signal_scope.

fixed_constraints: Lowering rule: every Can operation compiles to the equivalent native JavaScript/Bun operation, with adapters added only to enforce Can contracts and immutability. Zero external users: old syntax, ABI, layouts, and goldens carry no compatibility weight, so prefer the simpler compiler while semantics hold.

Catalogue authority: make_server_config(host:str, port:int, body_limit:int, shutdown_ms:int) -> server_config runs for real under assertions and emits invalid_server_config{reason:str}; server_start(config,router) -> server is fixture-supplied under assertions and emits bind_failed{address:str}; server_wait(server) -> void and server_stop(server) -> void are fixture-supplied and emit shutdown_failed{phase:str}. server_stop takes no deadline argument. The catalogue states no numeric ranges.

Ownership mechanics (runtime/owner.ts, reused unchanged): registerResource(kind,native,close,{idempotent,scopeManaged,shutdownMilliseconds}); closeResource(value,kind,deadline?) where a deadline bounds only that caller wait while the close continues; beginClose waits every outstanding lease then runs close once; closing an already-closing or closed non-idempotent resource fails with standard resource_state; guardCallback re-enters context-free native dispatch as a tracked task; scope close auto-closes open members with scopeManaged skipping only the failure report; a registered shutdownMs arms a drain timer that reports a cleanup failure while the close proceeds and is cancelled when close completes.

Measured Bun 1.4 behavior: Bun.serve binds synchronously; stop(closeActiveConnections?) returns void synchronously; stop(false) lets in-flight requests finish and refuses new connections; the default hostname is localhost; port 0 assigns an ephemeral port; out-of-range or non-integer ports throw RangeError synchronously; unresolvable or NUL-containing hosts throw synchronously; rebinding a used port throws Error code EADDRINUSE.

Task mandates: each request holds a server lease acquired and released exactly once; failures escaping dispatch become a sanitized 500 that never carries native causes, credentials, or domain payloads; signals and explicit stop converge on one close; server_wait must not settle merely because a different caller stop wait expired; stop(true) is forbidden beneath active work.
Settled by I32: snapshotRequest yields ok or rejected with status 400 for malformed ingress and 413 for over-limit bodies.
common.purpose: Act as a design adviser for Can, an immutable compiled language, using only the evidence in this request. No outside research, no implementation, and no explanatory prose in answers. The explicit uncertainty option is always acceptable when evidence cannot separate the candidates.

bind_address.facts: bind_failed{address:str} is server_start only emitted error. Native throws carry platform-shaped text (EADDRINUSE 'Failed to start server. Is port N in use?', getaddrinfo codes, RangeError internals). The sanitization mandate covers wire responses; bind failures go to the Can caller, not the client. No operator log channel exists besides late/cleanup diagnostics.

config_split.facts: make_server_config is pure validation without binding and runs for real under assertions; invalid_server_config{reason} is its only emitted error. server_start performs the bind and emits bind_failed{address}. Bun validates ports (RangeError) and hosts (synchronous resolution throw) at bind time. Statically decidable properties (integer ranges, empty string, NUL bytes, length caps) need no bind; resolvability and availability do.

lease_scope.facts: Measured: stop(false) lets an in-flight fetch finish (response body delivered, Bun drains its pending count) while refusing new connections. Adapter leases gate Can-side dispatch completion inside beginClose. Response bodies may stream after the fetch handler returns its Response.

numeric_bounds.facts: Sibling precedent ai-io max_body_bytes: 1-67108864 with default 8388608. Server configuration has no defaults since all four inputs are required. shutdown_ms drives closeResource caller deadlines and the registered drain bound, both implemented with setTimeout, which overflows above 2^31-1 ms (about 24.8 days) and fires early. body_limit bounds inbound buffering in snapshotRequest with no pre-allocation; reads stop at the limit.

phase_vocabulary.facts: server_stop takes no deadline argument; the only configured duration is shutdown_ms from server_config. closeResource accepts a caller-only deadline whose expiry reports failure while the close continues. Native stop(false) returns void synchronously. Distinct scenarios are caller-wait expiry, a throwing native stop, and a wait observing a failed close.

repeated_stop.facts: Task: verify repeated and stale operations against the resource-state rules. Non-idempotent closeResource on a closing or closed resource fails with standard resource_state. Idempotent closeResource returns the shared settlement completion instead. Signal and explicit-stop convergence either needs already-closing tolerance (non-idempotent plus swallowing) or falls out naturally (idempotent).

signal_scope.facts: Installing any SIGINT/SIGTERM listener overrides the default kill behavior for the whole process. server_wait is specified to listen for the signals; server_start has no signal role. Multiple servers and multiple waits per server are possible; close convergence is single at beginClose, where extra closeResource calls on a closing non-idempotent resource fail standard and are swallowed by the handler.
